tools.name: list_move_sizes
tools.description: Lists the home sizes iMoving prices moves for (from a few items or a studio up to a 5+ bedroom house), each with its id and the typical volume of belongings in cubic feet. Call it before get_moving_quote to pick move_size_id; the list rarely changes.

tools.name: get_moving_quote
tools.description: Gets real prices from vetted movers for a home move within the United States: how many movers can do it, the price range, and the best offers (the cheapest, plus the top-rated mover) with rating, reviews, price and a booking_url. Nothing is booked or stored.

tools.name: get_mover
tools.description: Gets a moving company's profile from iMoving: where it is based, years in business, moves done, its rating (1-10) and its most recent customer reviews (1-5 stars each). Use the mover_id of an offer from get_moving_quote.
